summary: Monolith architecture: SvelteKit frontend, Go (Gin/Echo) backend, PostgreSQL database on Fly.io.

frontend.justification: Matches team language(s): typescript; well suited to realtime_collab. Compiler-based, very fast pages with little JS. Smaller ecosystem and hiring pool.

backend.justification: Matches team language(s): go; well suited to realtime_collab; strong realtime/WebSocket support. Small binaries, excellent concurrency and latency; slower to iterate for beginners.

alternatives.why_not: Weaker scaling story at the expected user volume.

tradeoffs: More boilerplate for CRUD; slower iteration for junior teams.

database.justification: Well suited to realtime_collab; fits a write_heavy workload. The default relational choice: JSONB, full-text search, strong integrity, huge ecosystem.

hosting.justification: First-class support for the chosen framework(s). Runs containers close to users in many regions including Mumbai; good for realtime apps.
tradeoffs: Smaller managed ecosystem than the big clouds.

supporting.justification: Purpose-built WebSocket service in the backend language; you own scaling and fan-out.
Global cards and subscriptions; excellent APIs. PCI DSS handled via hosted checkout.
S3-compatible storage with zero egress fees; no India data-localisation guarantee.
Framework-native auth (Django auth, Devise, Passport, etc.). No third-party dependency.
In-memory cache for hot reads, sessions and rate limits.
General-purpose message broker with flexible routing.
Free-tier CDN, caching, WAF and DDoS protection.
CI/CD next to the code; free tier covers small teams.
Self-hosted metrics and dashboards; full control, some ops.

assumptions: Order-of-magnitude band, not a quote; real bills depend on traffic shape and discounts
